title: From tensor coordinates to one flat buffer
description: A quick reference for the tensor-shape, stride, and flat-storage terms used here.

terms.definition: A multidimensional interpretation of scalar values addressed through logical coordinates.
The ordered list of extents describing how many positions each tensor axis contains.
One independent dimension of a tensor, identified by its position in the shape.
The number of axes in a tensor, equal to the shape's length.
The number of valid index positions available along one tensor axis.
One zero-based index per axis that identifies a logical tensor element.
A storage convention in which the final coordinate changes fastest through the buffer.
The flat-buffer distance moved when one axis index increases by one.
The zero-based flat-buffer position selected by a valid multidimensional coordinate.
Keeping every tensor value together in one flat buffer under a fixed layout.
